# AI Study Notes Generator

## Project Structure

```
AI_Study_Notes_Generator/
├── app.py                      ← Main Streamlit app (run this)
├── requirements.txt            ← All dependencies
└── utils/
    ├── __init__.py
    ├── llm.py                  ← Hugging Face API helper (add your token here)
    ├── notes_generator.py      ← Generates structured notes
    ├── mcq_generator.py        ← Generates MCQs
    ├── cheatsheet_generator.py ← Generates cheat sheet
    ├── flashcard_generator.py  ← Generates flashcards
    ├── pdf_exporter.py         ← Exports everything to PDF
    └── docx_exporter.py        ← Exports everything to DOCX
```

---

## Setup & Run Instructions

### Step 1: Clone the repository
```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/AI_Study_Notes_Generator
cd AI_Study_Notes_Generator
```

### Step 2: Install dependencies
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Step 3: Add your Hugging Face API token
- Open `utils/llm.py`
- Replace `hf_YOUR_TOKEN_HERE` with your actual token
- Get a free token at: https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens

### Step 4: Run the app
```bash
streamlit run app.py
```

### Step 5: Open in browser
```
http://localhost:8501
```

---

## How to Use

1. Enter your subject name in the sidebar (e.g. "Operating Systems")
2. Select difficulty level: Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced
3. Paste your topic or syllabus text in the main text box
4. Click **Generate Study Material**
5. View your notes, MCQs, cheat sheet, and flashcards in the tabs
6. Download as **PDF** or **DOCX**

---

## Tech Stack

| Component   | Tool                        |
|-------------|-----------------------------|
| Language    | Python                      |
| UI          | Streamlit                   |
| AI / LLM    | Hugging Face Inference API  |
| PDF Export  | xhtml2pdf                   |
| DOCX Export | python-docx                 |
| Templating  | f-strings / inline HTML     |
